evidence_used: Visual appearance of a standard rectangular cardboard box with flat vertical sidewalls
Dry surface condition visible on the cardboard
Compatibility of gecko pads with reasonably flat cardboard surfaces despite mild texture
gecko.calculation_summary: Estimated base force of 2.5 N considering moderate gecko adhesion on flat cardboard sidewalls.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: No authoritative mass or friction measurements are available
Cardboard texture may slightly reduce optimal gecko dry adhesion compared to a perfectly smooth polished surface
Visual size estimation suggests a moderate weight box
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko gripper benefits from the flat, rigid parallel sidewalls of the cardboard box. While cardboard has minor surface texture and porosity that slightly degrades ideal mushroom-tipped pad adhesion, broad contact can still be formed, allowing a relatively low pre-grasp normal force of 2.5 N to achieve a secure hold.

evidence_used: Visual appearance of a standard rectangular cardboard box with flat vertical sidewalls
High friction silicone pads which perform reliably on textured paper/cardboard surfaces
silicone.calculation_summary: Estimated normal force of 3.2 N based on friction-based gripping requirements for a medium-sized cardboard box.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: No direct mass measurement is supplied, relying entirely on visual scale
Frictional coefficient between high-friction silicone and cardboard is assumed to be favorable
silicone.reasoning_trace: The high-friction silicone gripper relies primarily on normal force and friction rather than dry adhesion. Cardboard provides a great frictional interface for silicone pads. A moderate normal force of 3.2 N is estimated to safely lift the object without slipping.

comparison_evidence: Flat, parallel sidewalls of the cardboard box provide favorable geometry for gecko dry-adhesive pads
Gecko adhesion typically permits a lower required normal force than pure friction-based silicone gripping when surfaces are reasonably flat and dry
recommendation_summary: Both grippers are capable of handling the cardboard box. The gecko gripper is recommended because its dry-adhesive pads can achieve secure holding on the flat vertical cardboard sidewalls with a slightly lower required normal force (2.5 N vs 3.2 N).
